{

  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4 headers; TCP segment acknowledgment is indicated by TCP options or flags.",

}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4 packets; DNS queries are identified by query type A.",
    "Transport inclusion means any transport (UDP/TCP) used for DNS.",
    "mDNS is considered a subset of DNS over UDP at port 5353; mDNS queries follow standard DNS query format.",
    "Directional constraint applies to packet direction (source → destination) for query identification."
  ],
  "clarifying_question": null,
  "missing_slots": [],
  "display_filter": "dns.qry.type == 1 && (dns.proto == \"udp\" || dns.proto == \"tcp\")"
}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4 headers; DNS uses UDP/TCP transport.",
    "Request-side refers to the packet's role as a DNS query (not response).",
    "IPv4 address records correspond to DNS A records (type 1)."
  ],
  "clarifying_question": null,
  "missing_slots": [],
  "display_filter": "dns && dns.qr == 0 && ip.addr[0] != 0"
}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4 packets; DNS responses are identified by DNS query type (e.g., ANSWER, REFUSE) in standard DNS over UDP/TCP.",
    "TCP FIN packets are identified by TCP flags where FIN flag is set (tcp.flags.fin == 1).",
    "Directional constraints apply: source and destination are considered per packet; no aggregation across directions."
  ],
  "clarifying_question": null,
  "missing_slots": [],
  "display_filter": "tcp.flags.fin == 1 || dns"
}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "needs_clarification",
  "assumptions": [
    "Interpret the request at packet scope over complete Ethernet/IPv4 packets.",

  ],

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes complete IPv4 headers; DNS packets are identified by UDP port 53 and payload matching DNS query/response patterns.",
    "Non-DNS UDP packets exclude any UDP packet with destination port 53 (regardless of source port).",
    "IPv4 destination address range 10.0.0.0/8 includes all addresses from 10.0.0.0 to 10.255.255.255."
  ],
  "clarifying_question": null,
  "missing_slots": [],
  "display_filter": "udp && ip.dst >= 10.0.0.0 && ip.dst <= 10.255.255.255 && !(udp.dport == 53)"
}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4 headers; DNS decoding is based on application-layer identification (e.g., UDP payload matching DNS pattern or protocol heuristic).",
    "Private 10/8 address refers to destination IP address in the 10.0.0.0/8 range.",
    "Directional constraint applies to destination address (traffic headed to 10/8).",
    "UDP traffic not decoded as DNS means packets where the UDP payload does not match typical DNS query/response patterns (e.g., no obvious QNAME/QTYPE structure or no DNS response flags)."
  ],
  "clarifying_question": null,
  "missing_slots": [],
  "display_filter": "udp && ip.dst >= 10.0.0.0 && ip.dst < 10.255.255.255 && !(dns)"
}

{
  "schema_version": "direct-filter/1.0",
  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes complete Ethernet/IPv4 packets.",
    "Source and destination constraints are directional.",
    "DNS queries are identified by the presence of a question section with type AAAA.",
    "DNS NXDOMAIN responses are identified by the RCODE field being 3 (NXDOMAIN)."

{

  "status": "ready",
  "assumptions": [
    "Packet scope includes Ethernet/IPv4/IPv6 frames; DNS protocol is identified by application layer (port 53) or payload analysis.",
    "Directional constraints apply: source->destination for queries and responses.",
    "IPv6 address requests are identified by DNS query types A6 or AAAA; name error responses are indicated by DNS RCODE 3 (NXDOMAIN).",
